insights.one_liner: Zanders is a Dutch-founded consultancy for risk, treasury and SaaS in finance, an IND sponsor with a senior credit risk modelling job in Utrecht.

culture.text: Works for banks, insurers, lenders and asset managers on financial and non-financial risks, including ESG and AI.
The open senior consultant role in Utrecht builds credit risk models (IRB, IFRS 9, stress testing) that clients put into production.

open.text: Recognised IND visa sponsor through Zanders B.V.
Its one open job here does not require Dutch.
Started in the Netherlands and now works across Europe, the US, the Middle East and Asia.

growth.text: Opened a new office in Vienna to expand in the German-speaking region.
